name: InternVL2_5-8B
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, and the interesting part is that the vision tower is byte-identical to InternVL3-8B's while the LLM differs. (1) Vision: InternViT 24 layers, hidden 1024, 16 heads, patch 14, image_size 448 -- the same config as InternVL3-8B, minus the MoE scaffolding fields. downsample_ratio 0.5 + ps_version v2 = same 2x2 pixel-shuffle MLP projector, 256 tokens per 448 tile. (2) LLM: InternLM2-7B (architectures InternLM2ForCausalLM), 32 layers, hidden 4096, 32 heads / 8 KV, head_dim 128, intermediate 14336, vocab 92,553. ARCHITECTURE = dense. DYNAMIC TILING: identical to InternVL3 -- dynamic_image_size true, max_dynamic_patch 12, use_thumbnail true, so 2-13 ViT passes and 512-3,328 vision tokens per image. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES, same as InternVL3. KV CACHE: 32 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 131,072 B/token (128 KiB) -- 2.3x InternVL3-8B for the same vision tower and the same 8B param class, purely because InternLM2 has 8 KV heads over 32 layers instead of 4 over 28. This is the number that decides whether a model fits, and it is invisible in the param count. params_b 8.075 = HF API safetensors total (8,075,365,376). Interesting provenance note: gqa_ratio here is 32/8 = 4, i.e. this generation MOVED TOWARD more KV heads than Qwen2's 7:1, so the 'same size, more memory' pattern runs opposite to the usual trend.
